content:
**Moving Target** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Provides Evade chance while sprinting.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Gain +15% chance to Evade while sprinting. (No Power Armor) | 00323F8E | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain +10% chance to Evade while sprinting. (No Power Armor) | 001D2492 | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain +5% chance to Evade while sprinting. (No Power Armor) | 0004DDEE | 

Before update 60, the perk provided +15/+30/+45 Damage and Energy resistance while sprinting outside of power armor.
